subject: Last-mile vehicle ops for 2027-04 enterprise workshop (airport pickups, rentals, parking)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Last-mile vehicle ops for 2027-04 enterprise workshop (airport pickups, rentals, parking)

Team —

We have ACME Corp coming for the two-day exec workshop on Apr 5–6 (final attendee list attached). I want to lock down ground logistics by end-of-week so ops has time to finalize manifests and print badges. Key asks: 

- Airport pickups: 12 people arriving between 10:00–14:00 on Apr 5. Need 4 executive sedans (separate drivers for privacy), 1 shuttle for staff/overflow, and an on-call rideshare code for occasional late arrivals.
- Rental cars: 2 mid-size SUVs for onsite errands and a materials run on Apr 5; pickup from the city location recommended.
- Parking/dropoff: Venue has a tight curb. We need a 30-minute loading window at 08:00 on Apr 5 for AV load-in plus a reserved area for exec curbside drop-offs near the north entrance.

Can each of you confirm ownership and the preferred vendor by EOD Thursday? I can introduce to CityRide and the venue contact. Budget limit for car services is $1,200 day (excluding rentals).

Attachments: workshop_attendee_list.csv, venue_dropmap.png

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Events & Field Ops
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

From: CityRide Logistics <ops@cityride.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Last-mile vehicle ops for 2027-04 enterprise workshop (airport pickups, rentals, parking)

Hi Stephanie / Monica —

Thanks for the details and attachments. CityRide can cover the airport pickups and shuttle. Quick summary of options (pricing estimate attached as CityRide_SLA_v1.pdf):

Option A — Dedicated exec sedan fleet + 14-passenger shuttle
  - 4x exec sedans (door-to-door)
  - 1x 14-passenger shuttle for overflow
  - On-site liaison at the curb for 4 hours (covers staging and manifests)
  - Estimated: $1,050 for Apr 5 window (within your $1,200 day cap)

Option B — Mix of sedans + rideshare backup
  - 2x sedans + rideshare codes for ad-hoc pick-ups
  - 1x 10-passenger van instead of shuttle
  - Estimated: $780

We can also provide vehicle manifests (pickup_manifest_template.xlsx) and realtime ETA links for each trip. For parking permissions at the venue, we typically coordinate directly with the venue manager — please share the contact and any permit forms.

Attachments: CityRide_SLA_v1.pdf, pickup_manifest_template.xlsx

— Carlos Vega
Operations Lead, CityRide Logistics
ops@cityride.com | (555) 222-0199

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Last-mile vehicle ops for 2027-04 enterprise workshop (airport pickups, rentals, parking)

Stephanie / all —

I recommend we go with Option A from CityRide for executive arrivals (privacy + dedicated liaison makes the morning smoother). I'll take lead on bookings for the sedans and shuttle. Action items I propose: 

- Monica: Book CityRide Option A, request liaison from 09:30–13:30, confirm vehicle IDs and driver contact by Apr 1.
- Dev: Coordinate with Venue Park Garage for the 30-minute curb loading slot and reserve one adjacent blocked space for exec drop-off.
- Laura: I need sign-off on the $1,050 spend (will route through expenses).
- Vivek: Confirm rental car vendor preference — I can handle reservations but need the vendor.

I’ll submit the CityRide PO draft once Laura confirms.

Cheers,
Monica
Senior Events Manager
monica_patel@redwood.ai

From: Venue Park Garage <parking@venuepark.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Venue Operations <ops@venuepark.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reserved curb and loading window for Apr 5 — Redwood/ACME workshop

Hi Dev / Stephanie —

We received your request for a 30-minute loading window on Apr 5 at 08:00 and a reserved curbspace for exec drop-off near the north entrance. We can reserve the loading bay from 07:45–08:15 (our tightest slot) and place one temporary cone-reserved curbspace from 09:30–14:00. Please note: we need the vehicle manifest and license plate numbers 48 hours prior for access control.

Parking contact: Mark Ellis, Venue Park Garage — (555) 333-0102.

Regards,
Venue Park Garage Operations Team
parking@venuepark.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: CityRide Logistics <ops@cityride.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Last-mile vehicle ops for 2027-04 enterprise workshop (airport pickups, rentals, parking)

Thanks everyone — quick recap and next steps: 

- We are going with CityRide Option A. Monica, please issue the PO and request the liaison for 09:30–13:30. CityRide, please confirm driver names and vehicle plate numbers by Apr 3.
- Dev, thanks for locking the loading bay 07:45–08:15 and the cone-reserved curbspace 09:30–14:00. We will send the manifest 48 hours before (Apr 3 08:00 PST).
- Vivek, please share your rental vendor preference today; Monica will book 2 SUVs for Apr 5 pickup at the downtown location.
- Laura, please approve the $1,050 charge in the internal PO queue (I’ve added this to your approvals).

Once CityRide confirms the vehicle IDs and we have the manifest, I’ll circulate the final arrival schedule for ACME.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Events & Field Ops
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: pickup_manifest_template.xlsx
